verdict.rationale: GrowthBook supports separate environments (dev/staging/production) for feature flags, self-hosting via Docker Compose for a fully isolated instance, and a verified runtime probe confirms a keyless self-host roundtrip creating and evaluating flags without any production account/license — enabling true sandbox testing. missing for 10: no explicit vendor guidance on a dedicated 'sandbox mode' distinct from staging environments, and no independent (non-vendor) confirmation of environment data isolation guarantees.
